description_en: Initiates an outbound call from an intelligent contact robot
description_zh: 发起智能联络机器人呼出
name: RobotCall

parameters.help_en: The caller number for the outbound call. You can view this number on the Real Number Management (https://dyvmsnext.console.aliyun.com/number/list/normal) page of the voice messaging service
parameters.help_zh: 呼出主叫号码。在语音服务真实号管理 (https://dyvmsnext.console.aliyun.com/number/list/normal)界面查看
parameters.name: called_show_number

parameters.help_en: The robot ID, which is the script ID. You can view approved script IDs on the Script Management (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/patter/list) page
parameters.help_zh: 机器人ID，即话术ID。在话术管理 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/patter/list)界面查看审核通过的话术ID
parameters.name: robot_id

parameters.help_en: The ID reserved for the caller. This ID is returned to the caller through a receipt message. The value is 1 to 15 bytes in length
parameters.help_zh: 预留给调用方使用的 ID，最终会通过回执消息将此 ID 带回给调用方，长度为 1~15 个字节
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to record the call. Valid values:

false (default): Do not record.
true: Record
parameters.help_zh:
通话过程是否录音。取值：

false（默认值）：不录音。
true：录音
parameters.name: record_flag

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the number status identification feature. Valid values:

false (default): Disabled.
true: Enabled.
After this feature is enabled, the reason why a call is not answered is recorded
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用号码状态识别标识。取值：

false（默认值）：不启用。
true：启用。
启用后会记录通话未接听的原因
parameters.name: early_media_asr

parameters.help_en: The parameter list of the robot in JSON format. The total length cannot exceed 512 bytes. You can view the parameters on the Script Management (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/patter/list) > Details > Input/Output Parameters page or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2717999.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 机器人的参数列表。JSON格式。总长度不要超过512个字节。在话术管理 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/patter/list)>详情>输出输入参数中查看或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2717999.html接口查看
parameters.name: params

Code.description_en: The request status code. OK indicates that the request was successful
Code.description_zh: 请求状态码。返回OK代表请求成功

Data.description_en: The unique receipt ID of this call, which is the unique call ID
Data.description_zh: 此次通话的唯一回执ID，即呼叫唯一ID

Message.description_en: The description of the status code
